acceptanceCriteriaVerified: Given a complete synthesis request with initial seed data, When the end-to-end pipeline is executed, Then the system successfully synthesizes, renders, and audits a mockup that integrates with the asset service.
Given the full pipeline execution, When checking test coverage, Then unit, integration, and end-to-end tests validate all failure recoveries, including rendering timeouts and audit iteration limits.
notes: Verified end-to-end synthesis pipeline, asset service integration, timeout handling (RenderTimeoutException), and 3-round audit loop iteration limit recoveries.
